name: source-chip
title: Source chip
purpose: A compact link to where something came from: a file with an optional line range, a web page by its host, or a commit.
whenToUse: Under an agent's answer or beside an activity entry, to point at the file, page or commit it drew on.
For several sources in a row that wraps.
whenNotToUse: For a link inside a sentence. Use a plain link in the running text.
For a status. Use a badge.
For a file attached to a prompt, which can be removed. Use an attachment chip.
For a value the reader copies, such as a branch name. Use a copy field.

variants.name: file
variants.use: The file icon, the path split into ds-source-chip__start (the directories, with the last slash) and ds-source-chip__end (the file name), and an optional ds-source-chip__detail such as lines 42–58.

variants.name: url
variants.use: The external-link icon and the host alone in ds-source-chip__end. When it opens a new tab, add a ds-visually-hidden span reading (opens in a new tab).

variants.name: commit
variants.use: The git-commit-horizontal icon and the short hash in ds-source-chip__end, after a ds-visually-hidden span reading Commit.

sizes.name: default
sizes.use: Drawn 32px tall at every density. On a coarse pointer its pointer target is 44px tall through a padded hit area.

accessibility: Use an a element with an href that opens the source. The icon is decoration and carries aria-hidden="true".
Write the whole value as the link's text. The stylesheet cuts the middle from view only, so the accessible name keeps the full path. Do not add an aria-label that shortens it.

Split a path at its last slash, with no white space between the two spans: the start part ends in an ellipsis when room runs out, and the end part, the file name, stays whole until the chip is narrower than the name.
Write a line range in words, such as line 118 or lines 42–58, in ds-source-chip__detail.
The icon alone does not say the kind to a screen reader. A path and a host say it themselves. For a commit, start the text with a ds-visually-hidden span reading Commit.

Several chips are li elements of a ul with the class ds-source-chip__list, so a screen reader announces how many there are. On a coarse pointer its 12px gap keeps the 44px pointer targets of two rows apart. Outside that list, leave at least 12px above and below a chip.
Tab reaches each chip and Enter follows it. The component needs no script.
